title: No Dawn
description: A mod that introduces a mini-mode of endless night with mobs, mechanics and innovations
body:
No Dawn – A Survival Mod of Eternal Night

No Dawn is a dark, atmospheric survival mod for Minecraft. It transforms the game into a harsh, hopeless world where the sun no longer rises, and the player is left to survive in ruins surrounded by shadows.

🔹 Key Features:
🌑 Eternal Night: The world is locked in darkness.

🧟 Enhanced Undead: Custom mobs with unique textures and behavior.

🏚️ Ruined Villages: Spawn naturally, abandoned and overgrown.

🐟 Twisted Creatures: Encounter the monstrous Krovogryz.

🗣️ Atmospheric Elements: Random whispers, visual events, dark humor from the world itself.

🏆 Unique Advancements: Custom achievements with hand-drawn pixel-art icons.

🕒 Subtle Ending: After 5 in-game days, a quiet message appears — your story is now part of the world.

**For a full game in the mode, select - One Biome - Black Hollow**

**Be careful, the mod sets an endless night in all your worlds!**

This mod is designed to be short, harsh, and memorable.
If you enjoy it and want to see future updates, expansions, and more features — consider supporting me on Boosty to help me keep development going.
